content: RELAY ROUND 3 — Anthony shared four AI-generated visualizations of OMM/VDAC1 framework, plus the comment 'Write up in progress. Only if we could render this in real time.' Key methods observation: textual frame refinement (decision-gate → integration-surface; truth → disclosure; VDAC1-as-decider → VDAC1-as-readout-node) DID NOT propagate into the visual layer in 3 of 4 images. The visual grammar of 'central protein with arrows' naturally privileges the protein as actor; drawing the integration-surface frame faithfully requires membrane-as-protagonist with VDAC1 as one of several embedded readout nodes among co-equal lipid agents. Image 4 (Material Intelligence of the Membrane) is the only one that approaches this — lipids co-equal with proteins in the input mapping panel. Image 3 is the most compositionally polished but still anchored on 'VDAC1: the truth surface, the decision gate' in the title — the framing we'd already refined past. Methods note for paper write-up: integration-surface claim requires figures designed around membrane-as-protagonist, which is a different figure tradition than the field uses. Real-time renderer intuition is correct — the frame implies a simulator. State vector (6-8 variables: Bcl-2 ratio, HK-II occupancy, CL externalization, cholesterol, ROS, Ca, duration, network fraction) → scoring function with non-linear thresholds and MOMP hysteresis → attractor readout + trajectory. Offered to prototype as React toy artifact. The toy is also the load-bearing-ness test: if transitions feel right to trained intuition, frame is doing work; if arbitrary, frame is decoration.
